400.title: Bad request
400.description: The request is invalid or contains incorrect data.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: You must be signed in to access this page.

403.title: Access denied
403.description: You don't have permission to view this page.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

405.title: Method not allowed
405.description: This request method is not supported for this resource.

408.title: Request timeout
408.description: The server did not receive the request in time. Please try again.

409.title: Conflict
409.description: The operation cannot be completed because of a data conflict.

422.title: Invalid data
422.description: The submitted data could not be processed.

429.title: Too many requests
429.description: Too many requests were made. Please try again in a moment.

500.title: Server error
500.description: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again later.

502.title: Bad gateway
502.description: The server received an invalid response. Please try again later.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

504.title: Gateway timeout
504.description: The server did not receive a response in time. Please try again later.
